newsitem.title: CHINA: Bus crash kills 20 in southern China.
newsitem.headline: Bus crash kills 20 in southern China.

text.p: Twenty people were killed and several others seriously injured in a bus crash in southern China, a Chinese news agency said on Wednesday.
A highway bus carrying 40 passengers overturned in the outskirts of Zhaoqing in Guangdong province on Tuesday night, according to the China News Service.
"The bus overturned and caught fire," said a Zhaoqing municipal official, contacted by telephone.
Officials and the news agency said an investigation was under way, but no further details were available.
